scope: UAE school market, classroom capture product feasibility, competitors, privacy constraints, pricing scenarios, and incubator/funding paths

rails: Direct web searches for official UAE government, regulator, company, and vendor sources

social_checks.x: Tried via Agent Reach twitter-cli; HTTP 404, no usable results
social_checks.reddit: Tried via Agent Reach OpenCLI; no matching posts returned

not_done: No independent review of invoices, grants, or student counts

evidence.source: Kerala Startup Mission Kernel profile: Wynaut Labs Private Limited
supports: Profile lists incorporation date 2026-01-28 and founder Dev Nandan Anoop
Profile describes Maki as low-footprint hardware capturing teacher audio and producing notes, summaries, and tasks
Website markets Wy as classroom audio capture and notes software
Website names Trivandrum International School, Saraswathi Vidyalaya, and Loyola School
evidence.limitation: Named deployments are self-published vendor claims, not independently audited customer references.

evidence.source: KHDA Dubai private school sector data
supports: 227 private schools
387441 students
27284 teachers
17 curricula
6% student enrolment growth in 2024-25
evidence.limitation: Counts are from academic year 2024-25, not a 2026 census.

supports: KHDA says every private school in Dubai has a DLE report covering learning, teaching/monitoring, and leadership/management
evidence.limitation: This does not establish uniform classroom devices or current use of any specific learning platform.

evidence.source: Abu Dhabi Media Office / ADEK AI Literacy initiative
supports: AI literacy initiative across 170+ Abu Dhabi private schools
In-school technology and AI policy requires suitable infrastructure, staff capability, and responsible AI tools
evidence.limitation: Policy interest does not equal approval or willingness to pay for classroom recording.

supports: 183 UAE private schools
122000 paying students
36% of UAE private-school market

evidence.source: Alef Education release on private-school partnerships
evidence.source_type: company announcement filed through Abu Dhabi Securities Exchange
supports: Five school-group partnerships affecting over 33000 students across 28 schools
evidence.limitation: Adjacent learning platform deployment, not direct evidence of lecture recording.

supports: Audio lesson recording and analysis of classroom talk patterns for teacher reflection
Classroom camera, tracking, audio, and reflection tooling
Vendor says high-resolution camera is off by default and activated by user
Classroom lecture capture with screen/camera, scheduled recording, slide capture, and publishing to LMS/video portal
Multi-source video/audio/screen recording, live streams, and automatic upload to a video platform

evidence.source: Federal Decree by Law No. 26 of 2025 Regarding Child Digital Safety
supports: Law entered into force 2026-01-01
Restrictions on digital-platform processing of personal data for children under 13, subject to statutory conditions and an education/health exemption process
evidence.limitation: Product applicability and any exemption should be determined by UAE counsel and competent authorities.

evidence.source: UAE Government summary of Child Digital Safety Law
supports: Digital-platform scope and safeguards described by the government
Educational/health exemption depends on Cabinet resolution and safeguards

evidence.source_type: official Abu Dhabi education regulator policy
supports: Schools need procedures for consent in personal-information collection, processing, and storage
Written parental consent is required before taking student photos or video, with recording purpose disclosed
evidence.limitation: Abu Dhabi policy, not a Dubai rule.

evidence.source: Federal Decree by Law No. 45 of 2021 Concerning the Protection of Personal Data
supports: Personal data definition includes information identifying a person directly or indirectly, including voice and image
Law sets consent conditions, data minimisation, security, and retention principles
evidence.limitation: Scope, controller/processor roles, consent basis, and any applicable exemptions require case-specific review by UAE counsel.

evidence.source: ADEK Early Education Institution Surveillance Policy
evidence.source_type: official Abu Dhabi education regulator policy
supports: Policy defines surveillance systems as including live streaming
Policy requires explicit consent and details regulator approval and restricted access for live-streaming services
evidence.limitation: Scope is early education institutions; do not apply it as if it governs every school or emirate.

supports: Ideation/pre-MVP programme includes venture-builder support, Hub71 access, one-year licence/office support
Hub71 itself gives no direct funding through Initiate; venture builders determine funding/equity terms
EdTech is an eligible focus
AED 250000 in-kind and AED 250000 cash via SAFE for selected startups, with possible additional AED 250000 equity-linked top-up
Cohort 21 deadline listed as February 2027 and programme start September 2027
At least one founder expected to relocate long-term and build a team in Abu Dhabi
evidence.limitation: Selection is competitive; listed benefits are not guaranteed.

supports: On onboarding, a Tech Startup License / ADGM operating company is set up as a subsidiary of the holding entity

evidence.source: Mohammed Bin Rashid Innovation Fund FAQ
evidence.source_type: official UAE Ministry of Finance programme information
supports: Education is a priority sector
Accelerator does not provide direct funding
Separate Guarantee Scheme offers bank debt with a government-backed guarantee and requires post-ideation market-ready innovation
Tech startup facilities, workshops, investor access, and exhibition opportunities; applications open year-round
evidence.limitation: Published description does not promise direct grant funding.

evidence.source: Abu Dhabi Early Childhood Authority and Hub71 Anjal Z programme
supports: Programme targets early childhood, ages 0-8, and offers pilot access with up to AED 500000 combined cash/in-kind support for selected cohort members
Current page says applications are closed
evidence.limitation: The current classroom notes concept is not an obvious fit with stated early childhood priority areas.

evidence.source_type: official Kerala Startup Mission funding matrix
supports: Published grant tracks include prototype/productisation/scale-up and a research grant up to ₹30 lakh
Eligibility requires Kerala registration plus DPIIT recognition and KSUM unique ID
evidence.limitation: This does not establish that Wynaut received a grant or that a UAE company qualifies.
Mid-market reference only; not a transactional rate.
